subject: Forecast lock: pricing exception & deal desk approval needed for NovaPower
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast lock: pricing exception & deal desk approval needed for NovaPower

Team — quick heads up. NovaPower (SaaS energy analytics) has verbally agreed to move forward, but procurement is pushing for a 28% one‑time discount off our standard three‑year SOW to hit their budget. The reps (Neha + SE) negotiated the concession to save the deal but flagged the need for a deal desk entry and finance confirmation for the March forecast.

What I need from everyone: 
- Rishi: can you review the attached pricing-approval-form.xlsx and confirm whether the 28% is approvable under current discount bands or needs exec signoff?
- Vivek: if approved, can finance reflect a committed ARR and timing for recognition in the March lock? We need clarity on how this will impact the quarter.
- Monica: please update the HubSpot deal to reflect the proposed discount and mark stage to "Contract - Signing" only after approval.

Attachments: NovaPower_SOW_v3.pdf (redline included), pricing-approval-form.xlsx

I plan to escalate to Deal Desk by EOD if we don't have a decision — this materially affects our forecast.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast lock: pricing exception & deal desk approval needed for NovaPower

Laura / Neha — thanks. Quick questions before I route this to deal desk: 
1) Is the 28% applied to list MRR or is it a one‑time implementation credit? The SOW shows it as recurring on the invoice but the customer described it as a one‑time concession. Need this clarified for our ARR math.
2) Customer NRR / logo risk: is this expansion strategic (reference account) or pure revenue? The higher the strategic value, the more latitude I can push for.
3) Are there any requested SLA exceptions or data residency asks in the SOW redline? Those change risk and approval level.

I attached the pricing-approval-form.xlsx with preliminary fields filled — Neha, can you confirm the answers inline? If it's a one‑time credit and no SLA exceptions, I can probably approve up to 25% today; >25% requires deal desk + Head of Sales (written).

-Rishi
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast lock: pricing exception & deal desk approval needed for NovaPower

Rishi — answered inline and confirming details (see quoted):

> 1) Is the 28% applied to list MRR or one-time?

Neha: It's a mixture — the negotiation we landed is a 20% recurring discount on list MRR plus a separate one‑time implementation credit of 8% applied to the first invoice. I updated the pricing-approval-form.xlsx column B/C to reflect recurring vs one‑time.

> 2) Strategic value?

Neha: NovaPower is an early target for our energy vertical playbook and has a public roster of high-profile partners; marketing has asked for a short case study. Strategic = yes (high).

> 3) SLA/data asks?

Neha: No data residency changes in this SOW, standard SOC2 references only. Redlines are commercial only.

I also confirmed with the buyer (Sara) that they can sign the redlined SOW by EOD Thursday once pricing is approved.

—Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@novapower.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast lock: pricing exception & deal desk approval needed for NovaPower

Laura / Team — confirming we accept the commercial structure Neha outlined: 20% recurring discount + 8% one‑time implementation credit. We have gone internal and procurement is ready to sign once Redwood confirms approval. Signing ETA: Thu 05 Mar EOD.

Attached is the signed procurement checklist (stub) and an internal PO number; I will upload the signed SOW as soon as we have the final doc.

Thanks for moving quickly — Sara
Sara Lopez
Director, Procurement | NovaPower
sara.lopez@novapower.com
Attachment: NP_PO_987654.pdf (procurement reference)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast lock: pricing exception & deal desk approval needed for NovaPower

Thanks all — given the clarification from Neha and confirmation from the buyer, finance will include the deal as a committed ARR for the March forecast if the following are received before the close of business Wednesday (2026-03-04 PT):
- Signed SOW (PDF) or DocuSign completion (we need the signature event)
- Final pricing-approval-form.xlsx with Deal Desk signoff (I need Rishi's approval noted in the file or in email).

If Rishi confirms approval today for the combined 28% (20% recurring + 8% one‑time), I'll mark the deal as CLOSED‑WON in the forecast and reflect ARR impact pro‑rated from the PO start date. If Deal Desk requires exec signoff and we miss the window, we will move the deal to "pending approval" and it will not count in the March lock.

I'll prioritize the change once artifacts are in. Thanks for the quick coordination — please flag if you anticipate any delay.

-Vivek
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
